header.autoFixTooltip:
Auto-fix on Error — When checked:
If a runtime error occurs after [Run Preview], the AI will analyze
the error and modify the artifacts (JSX/Java/SP) automatically, then rerun.
Up to 3 retries; stops with a message if unresolved.
header.runPreviewTooltip: Convert JSX artifacts to AI mockups and render on the right [Preview] tab. Data is sample, SQL/Java apply is skipped (visual check only). First run takes 5-10s; subsequent runs are cached.
header.registerMenuTooltip: ① Register Menu — Apply only MENU_SQL to the actual DB (TB_AD_MENU + TB_AD_LANG_PACK + TB_AD_PERMISSION_GROUP)
header.applyArtifactTooltip: ② Apply Artifact — Save JSX/Java files + execute SQL_DDL/SQL_SP on the DB (recommended after Register Menu)
